title: Carter's 1976 UFO briefing by CIA director George H.W. Bush
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Carter's 1976 UFO briefing by CIA director George H.W. Bush, about 1976 at Plains, Georgia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 76 you know the first thing he did was he sent for the head of the Central Intelligence Agency to come down to Plains Georgia to brief him on the UFO issue and it turns out that person was George H W bush
